subject: Fwd: Scheduling performance deep-dive + load-test runbook
messages:
From: Elaine Cho <elaine@fathomai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fathomai.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: performance deep-dive + load tests for Fathom prod use case

Hi Karthik,

Great chatting briefly at the conference booth — thanks for offering to run a performance deep-dive for our team. We want a focused session to:
- Walk through Redwood's serving architecture for low-latency inference,
- Review a concrete load-test plan and expected token throughput targets, and
- Run a short smoke load test if possible (30-60 minutes) to validate p95 latency and token/sec numbers.

Context on our workload:
- Model: open-encoder-xxl (approx 32B), we will probably try a quantized variant.
- Typical request: 1k tokens input, ~512 tokens output (interactive summarization).
- Peak concurrent users: ~10 heavy interactive users; baseline concurrent across workers: ~40 short requests/min.
- Target: want to understand what sustained tokens/sec we can expect and expected p95 latency SLO for 1024-2048 context windows.

Can we schedule a 60–90 minute deep-dive next week? Our timezone is PDT. Available windows: Tue/Wed afternoons (3–6pm PDT) or Thu morning (9–11am). If you prefer we can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Cho
Head of Platform Engineering, FathomAI
elaine@fathomai.com

---
Attachment: sample_prompts.txt (text/plain)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Cho <elaine@fathomai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: performance deep-dive + load tests for Fathom prod use case

Elaine —

Thanks for the clear summary, and glad we met. We can run a focused 75-minute session that includes an architecture walk, test plan review, and a short smoke run. Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 11: 15:30–16:45
- Wed Aug 12: 16:00–17:15
- Thu Aug 13: 09:00–10:15

If none of those work, send a calendar link and we'll adapt.

Quick asks so we come prepared:
1) Can you confirm a realistic throughput target (tokens/sec) you want to validate?
2) Do you have a representative sample of prompts and output length (thanks for sample_prompts.txt)
3) Do you want us to run tests on Redwood hosted or a Private deployment (VPC)? If Private, please confirm network access and KMS details — that adds setup time.

Looping in Rishi (infra) — he will own the test-run config and the runbook.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Karthik / Rishi —

Thanks for the quick reply. Wed Aug 12 16:00–17:15 PDT works well for our team — please pencil that in if available.

To be explicit on targets we want you to validate during the session:
- Sustained throughput target: 4,500 tokens/sec across the test harness (target aggregate across all serving replicas).
- Concurrency: emulate 10 concurrent heavy interactive users, plus background traffic ~30 rps.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 250ms for generation up to 512 tokens output when using 1024 context (adjust for 2048 context in a separate run).
- Budget goal: give us indicative tpm-cost and what tradeoffs (batching / quantization) would be required to hit the numbers.

Attachments: I uploaded a short set of representative prompts (sample_prompts.txt). We can also provide a sanitized dataset if needed.

Notes: we will prefer hosted execution for the smoke test unless you advise otherwise. If hosted is fine, please confirm an API key / test endpoint and any IP allowlist steps.

Elaine
Elaine Cho
Head of Platform Engineering, FathomAI

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elaine Cho <elaine@fathomai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: performance deep-dive + load tests for Fathom prod use case

Elaine / Karthik —

Thanks — I sketched a technical runbook and initial test matrix (attached). High-level notes so the session is productive:

Planned test matrix (summary):
- Model variants: open-encoder-xxl (fp16), open-encoder-xxl-8bit (quantized).
- Hardware targets: A100-80GB (primary), single A30 as a lower-cost comparison.
- Batch strategy: dynamic batching with max_batch=32, preferred batch_latency_target=40ms.
- Warm-up: 5 minutes steady traffic to populate KV cache before measurements.
- Sequence lengths: 1024 context (primary), one run at 2048 to compare p95.
- Traffic pattern: 10 concurrent long sessions + Poisson background at 0.5s mean inter-arrival for short requests.

Targets to confirm:
- Aggregate tokens/sec target: 4,500 tokens/sec (we will split across replicas to measure per-replica throughput).
- Latency SLO: p95 < 250ms for 512-token generations on 1024-context.

Observability & artifacts we'll produce:
- Per-token latency distribution, per-replica CPU/GPU utilization, memory/KV cache hit rates, and cost-per-1k-tokens estimate.
- A short results summary PDF and the raw results CSV.

Attachments: load_test_matrix.xlsx (Excel) with run permutations, redwood-test-runbook.md (markdown) with commands and SDK snippets.

If you confirm hosted is ok, we will create a scoped API key for the smoke run (expires 48h) and share IP allowlist steps if needed. If Private/VPC preferred, we need 24h lead time for network setup.

Action items before Wed 16:00 (owners):
- Fathom: confirm hosted vs private + provide any IP ranges if private (Elaine).
- Redwood: prepare runbook + scoped API key (Rishi).
- Redwood: provision A100 test instance(s) and pre-pull model (Monica).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Scheduling performance deep-dive + load-test runbook

Elaine —

Quick update: Rishi finished the runbook and Monica has pre-pulled the model onto an A100 pool. We should still aim for Wed 16:00 PDT, but our VP just asked to move to Thu Aug 13 09:30–10:45 PDT to accommodate a cross-team attendee who is critical to the discussion. Apologies for the short shuffle — appreciate your flexibility.

I'll keep Wed 16:00 as a tentative hold until you confirm Thu works. If Thu 09:30 is fine I'll send an updated calendar invite and include the smoke test steps so your ops team can review.

Recap of what we'll deliver in-session:
- 20–25 minute architecture + kernel/quantization tradeoffs overview (Monica)
- 25–30 minute runbook & test-matrix walkthrough (Rishi)
- 20 minute smoke load run (hosted) + live metrics dashboard (if hosted allowed)
- Post-test summary: per-replica throughput numbers, p95/p50/p99, and cost estimate.

Attachments included in this thread: load_test_matrix.xlsx, redwood-test-runbook.md, sample_prompts.txt.

Please confirm Thu Aug 13 09:30–10:45 PDT and we'll send the updated invite and a short checklist for your ops team.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
